none: PAS NCL-381163: NCL-381163: Roman lead sealing
contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman lead seal. The seal is irregular in shape and has an oval cell stamped into it. Within the oval cell are the Greek letters 'ƐCθ' (epsilon, sigma, theta). Above and below the letters are two stylised branches of foliage. On the underside of the seal are grooves in the shape of a cross, radiating from a central raised knob.
